moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 2 & 3
moments.blurb: The Premier League continues with Matchweek 2 fixtures from Friday, August 28th, including Crystal Palace v Manchester City, and Matchweek 3 starting September 4th.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / The Guardian

angles.name: Weekend Kick-off
angles.copy: Premier League action returns this weekend! Who are you backing in Matchweek 2? Crystal Palace host Man City on Friday night. #PremierLeague

angles.name: Big Games Ahead
angles.copy: Following this weekend's games, Matchweek 3 is already on the horizon with some big clashes. Get ready for more Premier League drama!

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival
moments.blurb: Europe's biggest street festival, Notting Hill Carnival, returns to West London this Bank Holiday weekend from Saturday, August 29th to Monday, August 31st, celebrating Caribbean culture with music, parades, and food.

angles.name: Carnival Weekend Starts
angles.copy: Notting Hill Carnival kicks off this weekend! Get ready for three days of vibrant parades, incredible music, and amazing food in West London. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Vibes
angles.copy: Bank Holiday weekend means one thing in London: Notting Hill Carnival! Expect the best in reggae, dancehall, soca and more as the streets come alive.

moments.title: Creamfields 2026
moments.blurb: The legendary dance music festival Creamfields takes place in Daresbury, Cheshire from Thursday, August 27th to Saturday, August 29th, featuring headliners like Calvin Harris, Underworld, and Sonny Fodera.

angles.name: Creamfields Kicks Off
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 starts tomorrow! Who's ready for three days of the biggest names in dance music? Let's go, Daresbury! #Creamfields

angles.name: Dance Music Mecca
angles.copy: From Calvin Harris to Underworld, Creamfields is bringing the biggest beats to Cheshire this weekend. Expect epic sets and unforgettable moments!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festivals run from Friday, August 28th to Sunday, August 30th, with headliners including Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence And The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Raye.

angles.name: Reading & Leeds Weekend
angles.copy: It's almost time for Reading & Leeds! Who are you most excited to see this weekend? The festival gates open Friday for a massive lineup. #RandL26

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: From rock to pop to rap, Reading & Leeds has it all this year. Florence + The Machine, Dave, Charli XCX – it's going to be huge!

moments.title: Shambala Festival
moments.blurb: The independent and sustainable Shambala Festival takes place from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th, promising 'Adventures in Utopia' with a diverse music lineup and creative arts.

angles.name: Shambala is Back
angles.copy: Shambala Festival kicks off tomorrow! Who's ready to dive into four days of music, art, and radical sustainability? Expect the unexpected! #Shambala

angles.name: Adventures in Utopia
angles.copy: Beyond the music, Shambala offers a unique festival experience. If you're heading there, prepare for an adventure in utopia!

moments.title: Roseshire Festival
moments.blurb: Northamptonshire's new Roseshire Festival debuts on August 29-30, 2026, at Chester House Estate, featuring indie and alternative sounds on Saturday (The Charlatans, Embrace) and feel-good pop on Sunday.

angles.name: New Festival Alert
angles.copy: Northamptonshire gets a brand new festival this weekend! Roseshire Festival brings The Charlatans, Embrace and more to Chester House Estate. Who's in?

angles.name: Indie & Pop Weekend
angles.copy: Closing out summer with a bang! Roseshire Festival promises a mix of iconic indie and feel-good pop. It's set to be a stunning weekend.

moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1: Rein Me In
moments.blurb: "Rein Me In" by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 20-26, 2026.

angles.name: Current Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its reign on the Official UK Singles Chart. Are you still streaming it?

angles.name: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean
angles.copy: Massive congrats to Sam Fender & Olivia Dean for holding onto the top spot! 'Rein Me In' is proving to be the song of the summer.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence!

angles.name: Florence + The Machine
angles.copy: Celebrating the powerhouse vocals and unique style of Florence Welch today. 40 years young and still captivating audiences worldwide!
